name: Wideswell Reckoning
description: Open with a chop in the twin-court manner that invites the opponent to answer on one side.

name: Meteoric Rend
description: Step to the second seat of the court so the axe is placed to answer on the other flank.

name: Granite Greatbeard
description: Hold the haft across both hands in the pose of a court at rest and wait for the first blow.

name: Axescourge
description: Hew with the lead hand and swap hands for a second hew from the opposite side as qi follows.

name: Chime Haftrope
description: Parry with the haft and answer at once with the cheek of the head in the same motion.

name: Charter Hewfall
description: Press the head down on the opponent's weapon with qi until their seat in the exchange is lost.

name: Might Overhew
description: Cleave in a matched pair with the second stroke arriving through the opening of the first.

name: Vengeful Longhelve
description: Fall upon one seat of the opponent's guard and again upon the other until both give way.

name: Punishing Greatbit
description: Judge the opponent's guard with the first cut and deliver a decisive second cut with the full field behind it.

name: Grievous Sunder
description: Chop into the point where the opponent's guard divides like a river fork.

name: Vanishing Haftbell
description: Wade forward with low steady steps that keep the stance under the weight of the axe.

name: Aegis Doubleedge
description: Lift the haft like a bank against a surging blow and let the force pass to either side.

name: Veritytimber
description: Read what the opponent has stirred up in the ground and in the air to place the next cut.

name: Blaze Splitmass
description: Split one fall into two with a turn of the wrists so that both cut the same line.

name: Torrent Poleshoe
description: Send an incoming blow down the two sides of the haft as water passes a post.

name: Maiming Riven
description: Hook the beard under the guard and drag the opponent's weapon low as an undertow pulls a swimmer.

name: Titanic Overhew
description: Bring two falls in succession down the same line with the second following the first like a rejoining river.

name: Might Wideswell
description: Heap the qi field behind the head as flood water is heaped behind a bank and loose it in one cleave.

name: Corroding Tempered Greatbit
description: Let both falls meet in the target like two rivers at a mouth and sunder it with the joined weight.

name: Gust Haftbell
description: Fix the gaze on a single point of the foe and chop onto that point only.

name: Dazzling Longhelve
description: Throw the arms wide and step in a broad curve around the opponent's blind side.

name: Rampaging Greatpoll
description: Jab the horn of the bit forward like a beak at an exposed hand or wrist.

name: Heavyeye Ruin
description: Hew down with the bit curled like a talon so qi grips the target as it cuts.

name: Charter Greatpoll
description: Raise the axe and let out a sharp cry that freezes a foe in place for one breath.

name: Murk Doubleedge
description: Brush the flat of the head lightly against an incoming blade and turn it as a wing turns the air.

name: Rend Havoc
description: Hew from a high stance with the qi field gathered in the arms like a hawk's wings drawn back.

name: Blazesunder
description: Rise on a pulse of qi and cleave downward in a single descent from the top of the leap.

name: Splitmass Wrath
description: Dive onto the target with the whole field in the edge and rend guard and armor in one stroke.

name: Rivenruin
description: Chop along the rim of the opponent's stance to start the breaking of the basin.

name: Gustrend
description: Step down into the low ground of the stance where the opponent's weight is carried.

name: Poleshoe Tenacity
description: Curve the haft before the chest like the wall of a bowl and catch a blow along its curve.

name: Axerespite
description: Tap the haft on the ground and read the echo to find where the opponent's footing is poor.

name: Gust Haftrope
description: Hammer the flat of the head down onto the opponent's lead leg so the stance cracks at the floor.

name: Blistering Riven
description: Hew upward along the side of the basin wall and cut at an opponent who has stepped back.

name: Granite Sunder
description: Rest the head on the rim of the opponent's guard and press until they cannot lift out of the basin.

name: Hewfall Havoc
description: Fall into the center of the opponent's stance with qi sunk into the head and break its floor.

name: Blistering Poleshoe
description: Sweep low across a wide arc and shatter the footing of every foe standing within the basin.

name: Sanguine Sunder
description: Hew with the whole field behind the edge so the stance collapses inward under the stroke.

name: Iron Splitmass
description: Chop twice in a matched pair with the first stroke setting the place for the second.

name: Siltsunder
description: Pace out the width of the court with measured steps that match the length of the axe.

name: Unbudging Greatbeard
description: Hold the haft like a bar across two hands to stop a blow that comes down on both.

name: Veritygreat
description: Read which of the opponent's two hands holds the weight of the next stroke.

name: Gust Heavyeye
description: Let the edge fall once and rise at once to fall again before the first blow has settled.

name: Chime Haftbell
description: Parry with the haft and return a counterstroke with the head in a single paired motion.

name: Immobilizing Heavyeye
description: Hook the beard over the opponent's lead hand and pull it away so the pair of blows is broken.

name: Eviscerating Haftrope
description: Bring the edge down as one of a pair so that the second blow comes behind the first.

name: Eviscerating Riven
description: Double the weight of a cleave by following it with a second at once from the field.

name: Grievous Tempered Greatbeard
description: Fall with both edges of the court at once so that no guard is wide enough to cover them.

name: Rumblegreat
description: Chop at the weakest point of a defended line to start the breach.

name: Lightning Longhelve
description: Step along the second track toward the gap that the first stroke has opened.

name: Indomitable Doubleedge
description: Hold the haft across the track of the breach so that no counter can enter from the side.

name: Granite Greatbit
description: Hew down one track to open a line and across the second to widen it.

name: Mayhem Overhew
description: Hook the beard over a shield or spear in the line and wrench it aside to widen the gap.

name: Charter Rend
description: Hold the line down with heavy chopping presses so that its defenders cannot recover.

name: Wrathful Heavyeye
description: Cleave down one track and across the other in the same breath to force a clear breach.

name: Eviscerating Wideswell
description: Fall onto the center of a barred line like a splitting maul and drive qi through it.

name: Lacerating Haftbell
description: Drive both tracks of the stroke through a defended line so that the breach stays open behind the axe.

name: Gnashing Sunder
description: Chop at the foe who is stepping onto the ford before the second foot has landed.

name: Overhew Flash
description: Step stone to stone across the crossing while the head of the axe stays level.

name: Indomitable Longhelve
description: Stand in the current with the haft before the body and let blows break against it.

name: Illuminating Greatpoll
description: Read the ripples of the crossing to see how many foes are coming and where they will land.

name: Granite Riven
description: Cleave across the width of the ford so that anyone stepping into it meets the edge.

name: Vengeful Greatbeard
description: Hew low through the shallows at the legs of the crossing with qi cutting through the drag of water.

name: Unconquered Haftrope
description: Turn aside a blow with the haft by letting it slide downstream along the shaft.

name: Rumbletimber
description: Cleave through the middle of the crossing with qi along the full edge and deny the ford.

name: Downpour Greatbit
description: Sweep a wide arc across the crossing so that every foe entering the water is struck.

name: Hour Wideswell
description: Hold the crossing with relentless heavy strokes so that a surging mass cannot force its way over.

name: Might Doubleedge
description: Chop down twice as a pair of hawks dive upon a single prey.

name: Silt Rend
description: Drop into a long forward step that carries the axe along the line of descent.

name: Aegis Longhelve
description: Hold the axe up with both hands like a perch and wait for the target to come beneath it.

name: Gustriven
description: Hew down and then down again in the pattern of paired hawks with qi running between strokes.

name: Intent Splitmass
description: Press a descending head against the opponent's guard while the second stroke waits above it.

name: Enthralling Hewfall
description: Seize the opponent's weapon with the beard and a hand and wrench it out like paired talons.

name: Hewfall Scourge
description: Dive in the pattern of paired hawks and land two cleaves along the same descending line.

name: Gust Splitmass
description: Make two descents at once with mortal strength carried to its peak and the qi netted behind the head.

name: Mightriven
description: Strike with the full mortal strength and its qi net at the peak of a double hawk descent.

name: Gust Poleshoe
description: Chop along the line that the wind has been sworn to carry the head upon.

name: Phantom Overhew
description: Step into the gap that the wind has opened in the opponent's cover.

name: Thorngreat
description: Hold the haft before the body and let the sworn wind turn blows aside.

name: Timberrespite
description: Read the gusts on the edge of the axe to know the direction and weight of the foe's stroke.

name: Timberruin
description: Hew with the wind sworn behind the stroke so that qi need only hold the line.

name: Unbowed Wideswell
description: Parry with a quick turn of the haft and let a gust sweep the blow away from the body.

name: Numbing Poleshoe
description: Hook the beard around a guard and pull with the wind at the back to topple the foe.

name: Brutalizing Doubleedge
description: Cleave through the guard with the sworn wind pressing the head forward at a speed no arm could give.

name: Sunderruin
description: Fall with the weight of a sworn gale on the head and the whole field in the edge.

name: Hellish Nova Heavyeye
description: Sunder the target with a stroke whose edge the sworn wind drives through armor and body at once.

name: Greatwrath
description: Chop straight along the line drawn across the plateau and let no foot cross it.

name: Sunderblink
description: Walk the line in short steps while the axe keeps the foe on the far side.

name: Aegis Greatbeard
description: Hold the haft against the open sky so that a blow from above meets wood and not flesh.

name: Axehavoc
description: Hew along the line with qi settled in the legs so that the stance does not shift.

name: Torrent Haftrope
description: Parry with the haft and let the wind off the plateau edge carry the blow aside.

name: Intent Greatpoll
description: Lean the weight of the head against the foe's guard and press them off the line.

name: Rivenhavoc
description: Hew with the full field along the line so that the stroke ends only where the line ends.

name: Pitiless Hewfall
description: Fall upon the foe at the line with a weight that holds the line against any charge.

name: Grievous Haftbell
description: Cleave along the line with the field behind the edge so that the line stays whole after the stroke.

name: Tempered Sunder
description: Chop on the bearing the oath has fixed and keep the edge from straying.

name: Granite Rend
description: Step forward on the oath and refuse to give back the ground gained.

name: Unrelenting Greatbit
description: Hold the edge upright before the body as a sworn barrier against a descending blow.

name: Waningtimber
description: Check the edge against the oath and read whether the foe's guard has drifted from its mark.

name: Timberscourge
description: Hew with the oath-held edge so that qi keeps the cut exactly where it was sworn.

name: Invincible Greatpoll
description: Parry on the held edge and turn the opposing blade without letting the edge move.

name: Toxin Heavyeye
description: Drag the beard along the opponent's weapon and pin it to the ground at the sworn point.

name: Rendruin
description: Bring the held edge down with the full field and nothing allowed to deflect its bearing.

name: Wrathful Riven
description: Cleave through any guard with an edge that does not yield to the force of the contact.

name: Sunderhavoc
description: Drive the sworn edge through the guard on its fixed bearing so no defense turns it aside.

name: Blaze Haftrope
description: Chop across open ground with room on all sides for the full swing.

name: Sunderflash
description: Walk toward the foe on a bearing taken from a fixed mark on the horizon.

name: Facettimber
description: Set the haft into the wind off the plateau and guard behind it like a post.

name: Blaze Wideswell
description: Hew on the plateau bearing with qi guiding the head across open ground to its mark.

name: Murkaxe
description: Cross the foe's bearing with the haft and turn their blow from the line of approach.

name: Silt Splitmass
description: Sweep the head slowly along a bearing and hold it so that anyone crossing it is struck.

name: Gnashing Haftbell
description: Hew across open ground with the full field and let the wind carry the stroke past the guard.

name: Rend Devastation
description: Hold the bearing across the plateau while qi gathers and loose it in a single long cleave.

name: Ferocious Greatpoll
description: Sunder the foe on a bearing held across the whole plateau with the field driving the edge.

name: Longhelve Reckoning
description: Chop at one man in a drawn line and force him back out of it.

name: Torrent Riven
description: Step in on a gust and push into the gap the first chop has made.

name: Greatbeard Hardihood
description: Guard with the haft against the foes on either side of the gap just torn open.

name: Elevating Greatbit
description: Read the draft of the line breaking to see which man will close the gap first.

name: Rumble Doubleedge
description: Hew into the line with the wind pushing the head so that the cut tears the formation.

name: Toxin Overhew
description: Hook the beard into the shield rim of one man and wrench until the line opens.

name: Decimating Doubleedge
description: Press the head down on a man's guard with the gale at the back to keep him from rising.

name: Rumbleaxe
description: Cleave through the line with the wind tearing at the foes on either side of the stroke.

name: Mayhemtimber
description: Sweep across the whole front and tear the line from end to end with a gale at the edge.

name: Corroding Haftbell
description: Loose the full field in one sweep so that the foes in a drawn line are torn from their places.

name: Sunderwrath
description: Chop through the pressure of a gale so that the edge keeps its line against the force.

name: Silt Heavyeye
description: Step on the draw of a gale that is pulling back and close ground in its wake.

name: Iron Poleshoe
description: Cover the body with the haft held against the gale so blows are pressed aside.

name: Booming Rend
description: Hew straight through a gust so that the edge is not turned by any force from the side.

name: Murk Haftrope
description: Turn a strong blow with a pulse of qi and let the gale draw it past the body.

name: Hourriven
description: Press repeatedly into the foe with strokes that carry a gale's weight and give no breathing room.

name: Blazeaxe
description: Cleave with the whole body behind a gale-driven edge and split a guard along its grain.

name: Berserk Sunder
description: Bring the head down with a gale's weight behind it to crush a raised guard.

name: Gust Overhew
description: Cleave with the field gathered about the edge so that the gale itself helps to sunder the foe.

name: Iron Greatbeard
description: Chop along a bearing sworn before the stroke is made and do not alter it.

name: Silt Greatpoll
description: Lock the feet onto the bearing with a short step so the body follows the axe.

name: Timberspine
description: Cross the haft over the bearing line to meet a blow aimed across it.

name: Chime Wideswell
description: Read the bearing of the foe's own stroke to see where it will end.

name: Might Poleshoe
description: Hew on the sworn bearing so that qi drives the head along it without correction.

name: Unbowed Longhelve
description: Turn the foe's stroke along its own bearing and send it past the body.

name: Intent Greatbit
description: Press along the sworn bearing with heavy strokes so that the foe has no line to answer on.

name: Blaze Haftbell
description: Drive the great stroke down the sworn bearing with the full field and no pause for correction.

name: Sunderscourge
description: Fall along the sworn bearing so that all of the stroke's weight lands where it was aimed.

name: Gnashing Glint Sunder
description: Drive the edge along its sworn bearing through guard and body so the stroke does not turn back.

name: Riven Wrath
description: Chop from a stance with open ground behind and to each side of the wielder.

name: Torrent Greatbit
description: Step forward and back over open ground while no wall or post stands near to lean upon.

name: Axevalor
description: Guard the exposed flank with the haft and keep the head turned toward the nearer foe.

name: Rendwrath
description: Hew with the full body in a stance that needs nothing behind it to hold.

name: Torrent Heavyeye
description: Parry a flanking blow with the haft and turn on the lead foot to face the attacker.

name: Shaderend
description: Press foes back on all sides with heavy strokes that cover the open ground around the wielder.

name: Hewfall Wrath
description: Cleave across open ground with the full strength of the body and nothing built to guard the back.

name: Rampaging Splitmass
description: Fall onto the foe with the weight of the whole body and a net of qi held about the head.

name: Rendscourge
description: Strike with the whole strength of a body that holds ground on its own and a field behind the edge.
